notes.title: Huge Puzzle Drop & More Coming Soon
notes.content:
We are on the cusp of a significant update to Blockwick 2. The biggest part of the update will be all 144 puzzles from Blockwick 2 Basics. These puzzles are easier puzzles that are great for a more casual, less brain intensive experience. 

Due to popular demand we are also adding Steam Cloud support. You'll be able to keep your game progress across multiple computers.

And finally we're also adding French and Spanish translations. Voila!

- Kieffer Bros.
